name: infra-across-scale-test
description: Scale test template: measure how many VMs can be created per CSP in Korea-nearby regions. nodeGroupSize is the size that actually provisioned in the latest run (2026-08-23, 808 requested / 677 running); per-group descriptions record the observed limit and its cause (account quota vs. zone stock).

nodeGroups.name: g1-alibaba-ap-northeast-2
nodeGroups.description: Alibaba - Seoul (ap-northeast-2) | Limit: zone stock, not quota — 2026-08-23 ecs.e-c4m1.large hit OperationDenied.NoStock after 79 VMs (us-east-1 confirmed 200 on 2026-08-22). Set 100; raise if stock allows

nodeGroups.name: g2-aws-ap-northeast-2
nodeGroups.description: AWS - Seoul (ap-northeast-2) | 200 confirmed (2026-08-22, 2026-08-23); account limit not yet reached

nodeGroups.name: g3-azure-koreacentral
nodeGroups.description: Azure - Korea Central | Limit: 50 VMs (standardBSFamily vCPU quota 50 cores; B1ls=1vCPU); 50 confirmed 2026-08-23

nodeGroups.name: g4-gcp-asia-northeast3
nodeGroups.description: GCP - Seoul (asia-northeast3) | 200 confirmed (2026-08-22, 2026-08-23); account limit not yet reached

nodeGroups.name: g5-ibm-jp-osa
nodeGroups.description: IBM - Osaka (jp-osa) | Limit: Floating IP quota 40 per region; 36 provisioned on 2026-08-23 (4 rejected: 'Creating a new floating IP address will put the user over quota'); set 36

nodeGroups.name: g6-kt-kr1
nodeGroups.description: KT Cloud - Korea (kr1) | Limit: public IP quota (~15); 15/15 confirmed 2026-08-23 after releasing leftover public IPs — creation fails with 422 '사용 가능한 공인 IP가 없습니다' while old IPs are held

nodeGroups.name: g7-ncp-kr
nodeGroups.description: NCP - Korea (kr) | Limit: 3 VMs (G3 Standard VM account quota 5; 2 slots used by non-TB servers); 3 confirmed 2026-08-23

nodeGroups.name: g8-nhn-kr1
nodeGroups.description: NHN - Korea 1 (kr1) | Limit: ~50 VMs (public IP allocation fails at the 51st); 49/50 on 2026-08-23 (1 network timeout)

nodeGroups.name: g9-tencent-ap-seoul
nodeGroups.description: Tencent - Seoul (ap-seoul) | Limit: 50 (LimitExceeded.InstanceQuota) and zone stock — 45/50 on 2026-08-23 (4 ResourceInsufficient.SpecifiedInstanceType); API limit 10 req/s needs low create concurrency
